entries.description_en: Bar Brawl

The Genius Invokation TCG Society has determined that you are qualified for the Ascension Challenge. Win the Challenge and become a Legend player! We hope you will have fun with Genius Invokation TCG!
Gygax from Mondstadt seems to be busy with something...

entries.source_name: The Call of Mystical Martial Arts
entries.description_en: An Adventurer wants to seek out the legendary martial arts of Liyue, yet no sooner had they set foot on the road than they ran into mortal danger...

entries.source_name: The Many Matters Learned in One's Travels
entries.arabic_name: أمور كثيرة تعلمها المرء في رحلاته
entries.description_en: Katheryne of the Adventurers' Guild seems to be looking for you...

entries.source_name: Playing in the Snow Counts as Training Too!
entries.arabic_name: اللعب في الثلج يُعد تدريباً أيضاً!
entries.description_en: Looks like Klee has had quite the unusual encounter during the Cross Country Challenge. Let's go check on her now!
Thanks to recent exchanges with friends from different nations, Mika from the Reconnaissance Company has reached a new milestone...

entries.source_name: Serendipitous Encounters and a Curious Consensus
entries.description_en: You run into two old friends near the Dragonspine International Cross Country Challenge camp. A meeting between them is something you haven't considered until now...

entries.source_name: Greetings From the Knights of Favonius
entries.description_en: Amber seems to be looking for you...

entries.source_name: A Surprise From a Fellow Comics Fan
entries.arabic_name: مفاجأة من معجب آخر بالقصص المصورة
entries.description_en: Yoimiya seems to be looking for you...

entries.source_name: An Invitation From the Spark Knight
entries.description_en: Klee seems to be looking for you...
Helen from Mondstadt needs 10 Sweet Flowers.
The Dawn Winery's Connor requires ten servings of Wheat.
The Dawn Winery's Connor requires three sets of Dandelion Seeds.
The Dawn Winery's Connor requires three Flaming Flower Stamens.
The Dawn Winery's Connor requires three Mist Flower Corollas.
Timmie from Mondstadt needs ten servings of Wheat.
Alfred from Mondstadt needs three Cecilias.

entries.source_name: Manly Jack's Manly Journey of Manliness
entries.arabic_name: رحلة جاك الرجولية بكل معنى الكلمة
entries.description_en: Manly Jack needs three Chicken-Mushroom Skewers.
Springvale's Brook requires six servings of Raw Meat.
Springvale's Brook requires six servings of Fowl.

Swan does everything by the book — specifically, by the Knights of Favonius Handbook. Previously, Swan wouldn't ask anything of the Traveler, who was not a Knight then. Now that the Traveler is an Honorary Knight, Swan will sometimes quiz the Traveler concerning the contents of the Handbook.
According to Joel, Cyrus has found some leads as to his father's whereabouts...
Viktor is looking for someone to help him gather some local specialties...
The storm has just ended, and Cyrus from the Adventurers' Guild is currently planning to clear the Treasure Hoarders out...

While investigating the movements of monsters at the Thousand Winds Temple, Jack was discovered due to his recklessness and attacked. Jack somehow made it back to Mondstadt, but he seems to have left something important behind at the Temple...

entries.source_name: A Quiet Day in Liyue Harbor
entries.description_en: Nervous An, busy at the harbor, is looking for someone to help to ease the nerves of guests from other nations...
Nine stone pillars stand stoic near Cuijue Slope. They seem to hide a certain secret...
You met a strange person on Mt. Tianheng who is looking for someone to play hide-and-seek with him...
There is a strange tablet in Tianqiu Valley that seems to relate some of the valley's history...
You reach an uninhabited island across the sea, which is home to an enigmatic sundial. Who knows what secret it holds?
Clerk Zhao is so swamped with work that she can't even get a moment to herself. It seems she could use some assistance...

entries.source_name: No Restoring This Past Land of Beauty
entries.arabic_name: لا سبيل لإعادة جمال هذه الأرض الماضية
entries.description_en: Zhiping of the Adventurers' Guild seems to be investigating the earthquakes and strange monster movements in Tianqiu Valley...

entries.source_name: Verses and Vistas of Lantern Rite (Part II)
entries.arabic_name: أبيات ومناظر طقوس الفوانيس: الجزء الثاني
entries.description_en: Painter Vermeer seems to be looking for Qingzhou...
Although the incident in The Chasm has come to a close, Zhiqiong is still involved in other exploration work. Best you go check in on her...
Now that you have destroyed the Bedrock Keys, the seal on The Chasm has now come undone. It is time to venture into the depths below.

entries.source_name: Valor's Afterglow: The Faint Light Remembered
entries.description_en: Zhiqiong seems to have left the exploration team to explore on her own. Still, it's too dangerous to go alone into The Chasm, so she must be found...
Investigate the mysterious environs beneath the stone and take pictures related to the black mud.

entries.source_name: Meeting New People... and Foiling Some Bandits
entries.arabic_name: لقاء أشخاص جدد... وإحباط بعض قطاع الطرق
entries.description_en: As you explore the lower levels of The Chasm, you discover Treasure Hoarders. If they think you'll let them do things as they please down here, then they've got another think coming!

The strange crystal plummeted toward the ground and shattered it, revealing an entrance to even greater depths. Who knows what's down there... But either way, it would be best to proceed with caution.
You notice some rocks with peculiar markings on them. It's better to take a few pictures. Perhaps someone might know what these are...

The Treasure Hoarders who were behaving oddly turned out to be Millelith in disguise. In response to the resultant situation, their leader asks for your aid in taking out the Treasure Hoarder camps...
You run into a less-hostile Fatui mage in The Chasm. What is she doing here?

entries.source_name: Lost in a Foreign Land: Seeking
entries.description_en: You run into a Fatui mage named Katarina who is wandering alone in The Chasm. What is she doing here? Ask her what's going on.
A Treasure Hoarder at the top of The Chasm claims to be from the Guhua Clan. Is he crazy, or is he just lost? Or is there some other secret that lies behind this situation?
The bard Taliesin seeks your help. As it turns out, the ring that he stole from the Weasel Thieves has been stolen once again by another bunch of Weasel Thieves...
You meet two oddballs at Wangshu Inn...
On first arriving at Chenyu Vale, you are asked by the adeptus, Fujin, to help investigate imbalances in the local water and soil...
Little Mao seems to have some information about how to help heal Chenyu Vale...
At night, out in the wild, you encounter a little girl standing on a bamboo raft...
The teapot troubles are still causing Uncle Luo quite the headache...
Hezhe Post seems to be organizing an interesting event named "Our Chenyu Vale Trek"...

entries.source_name: The Cloud-Padded Path to the Chiwang Repose
entries.arabic_name: الطريق المكسو بالغيوم إلى مرقد تشيوانغ
entries.description_en: Paimon is a bit worried about Adeptus Fujin's condition. If you have time, it might be good to pay another visit to Chiwang Terrace.
Paimon's heard that some guests from other nations have come to Liyue Harbor to take part in a local event. You decide to go see what's happening...
The cooperative wargame being hosted by the Millelith is almost over. But it seems like Su Ding still has something to say to you...
Following Pingxi's suggestion, you decide to look for the Auspicious Treasure Tree...
Following Pingxi's suggestion, you decide to check out the Bulletin Board...
Following Pingxi's suggestion, you decide to release a Celebratory Xiao Lantern... Or would a Gift Xiao Lantern do just fine as well?
Cloud Retainer seems to have invented a new cooking device...
Katheryne seems to be having some trouble with a commission that concerns The Chasm...

entries.arabic_name: تقرير الدورة الذاتية للمسمار: سجل البيئة
entries.description_en: While you attempted to move the Pursina's Spike into the frontline mines, you face a significant number of obstacles...
The Sumeru researcher Khedive, who is conducting research as part of the exploration team, seems to be troubled about the environment within The Chasm.
Assist the researcher from Sumeru in initializing the Pursina's Spike to clear the dark mud from the mining complex of The Chasm.
The Spike is gradually sealing the Ley Line rupture up. Inform Hosseini of this result.
In Liyue Harbor, an adventurer is busy with a certain task...
During Lantern Rite, Huixing, the navigator of the Crux fleet seems to be preparing for a unique training test...
During Lantern Rite, Tiantian, a recruiter for the Adventurers' Guild, is eagerly rubbing her hands together in anticipation of an interesting event...

entries.source_name: A Few Words in the Foreground
entries.description_en: There's a performance going on at the North Wharf. Don't hesitate to come along if you're interested.
Thanks to you, the performance of Homeward, Bravebeard went smoothly, but it seems that Yinggong has something to say to you...

After having gone through the Arataki Blazing Armor Beetle Battle Boot Camp, Arataki Itto seems to have realized that the strength of Onikabuto is ultimately limited, and a bold new plan is hatched within his mind...

During the Lantern Rite Festival, you and Paimon run into Gaming and another friend practicing the Wushou Dance together. He has prepared an endlessly fascinating event, and is waiting for guests to come and experience it...
As you pass by a lane in Yilong Wharf, a sincere Storyteller's disciple approaches you and narrates a tale intimately related to you both...
Someone seems interested in creating a Gift Envelope...
Someone seems interested in creating a Gift Envelope...
Someone seems interested in creating a Gift Envelope...
Someone seems interested in creating a Gift Envelope...
Someone seems interested in creating a Gift Envelope...
Someone seems interested in creating a Gift Envelope...
A Millelith soldier seems to be troubled by something...

entries.source_name: The Vishaps Lie Dormant, but the Enigma Lingers Still
entries.arabic_name: الفيشاب ساكنة، لكن اللغز لا يزال قائماً
entries.description_en: After a sustained effort, you seem to have scared the Geovishaps into submission and the disturbances across the land seem to have subsided. However, the reason for their re-emergence and rampage remains a mystery...
Yingzhu of the Adventurers' Guild has been having dealings with a scholar from the Sumeru Akademiya, but things seem to be going downhill, fast...
The Smoldersleet Potion's phased trials are over. It is time to report back to Timaeus...
Katheryne of the Liyue Harbor Adventurers' Guild seems to be looking for you...
A person from Sumeru has arrived at the wharfs of Liyue Harbor. She seems to be in a bit of a fix...
A certain researcher from Fontaine is currently performing some esoteric research in The Chasm.
You receive a very strange commission. Go to the area around the Pyro Regisvine to learn more from the client.

entries.source_name: Arataki Blazing Armor Beetle Battle Boot Camp!
entries.arabic_name: معسكر تدريب معركة خنفساء درع أراتاكي المشتعل!
entries.description_en: Your diet has been quite plain recently, and Paimon's been missing the spice of life in food...\nAs such, you head over to Wanmin Restaurant, only to meet two old friends...
After the Pyro Regisvine, Ranjit's next target is a Primo Geovishap...
The Claw Convoy animal rescue society's gift-swapping event has ended. Zhenchen is sorting through the gifts that the society has received...
The Adventurers' Guild has reported strange activity in Liyue's Sal Terrae, and the Millelith have sealed the area off. Sensing danger, you and Paimon decide to head over to investigate...
Having successfully ventured into the Ley Line disturbance's hidden Domain and emerged victorious from its trials, it's time to report back to Keqing and Yelan...
You run into someone who loves listening to stories in Liyue Harbor...
You bump into a painter who offers free souvenir paintings for tourists in Liyue Harbor...
You come across a strange stall in Liyue Harbor...
Liyue Harbor's Herbalist Gui needs three Qingxin.
Liyue Harbor's Herbalist Gui needs three Violetgrass.
Wangshu Inn's Smiley Yanxiao needs two Hams.
Hanfeng from Qingce Village needs ten Iron Chunks.
Yi Zhu needs a serving of Almond Tofu.
Lan seems to be fretting over some of the commissions that the Adventurers' Guild has undertaken...

entries.source_name: Words Worth Their Weight in Mora
entries.description_en: The recent crisis that beset Liyue Harbor has reinvigorated interest in history. Wanwen Bookhouse has seen a resurgence in business as a result, and its owner Jifang is on the verge of being overwhelmed...
Changchang from Liyue Harbor is looking for someone to get some food for a little puppy...
You meet Alrani, whom you once saved from a cage, in Liyue Harbor. She still seems to want to investigate something...
Xu of the Feiyun Commerce Guild is currently puzzling over a device known as a Kamera...
Lan of the Liyue Harbor Adventurers' Guild seems to be troubled by something...
You learn from a Millelith named Kun that there are plans to rebuild the previously destroyed Jade Chamber and that some small preparations to that end are already taking place...

In the aftermath of the collision between the Jade Chamber and That Which Lies in the Deep, the sea remains dotted with floating fragments of the Jade Chamber. The Millelith soldier Kun is currently looking for help with the cleanup work...
Wang'ya has something to say to you at Wangshu Inn...
While most people from Liyue are enjoying the Lantern Rite, guard-for-hire Huangshan is currently in a bit of a fix...
Smiley Yanxiao from Wangshu Inn seems to be struggling with his workload during the Lantern Rite...
Ms. Bai from Qingce Village seems to be making some preparations...
Wang'ya from Liyue Harbor seems to be troubled by something...
While everyone else is lifting their eyes up to the lovely sight of Xiao Lanterns in the sky, Millelith soldier Hongyu is having a headache...
The scholar Soraya seems to be investigating something in Mt. Tianheng...
The festival is in full swing, but Zhi of Qingce Village is trying to remedy a herb-related predicament...

entries.arabic_name: ما بعد الحياة: كل شيء بخير
entries.description_en: Wang Ping'an wants to renovate Pervases' temple. You wonder how much progress he's making...
A mysterious, masked shrine maiden is by the strange fox statue, seemingly with something to request of you...

According to Hanachirusato, these barriers must be broken to cleanse the Thunder Sakura's roots. The next barrier seems to be located in the abandoned shrine to the northeast of Konda Village. Although the place sounds quite unsettling indeed, this is Hanachirusato's request, so it is best that you see it done.
Xavier, who is researching the Mikage Furnace, seems to have had some new idea...
Xavier, who is researching the Mikage Furnace, seems to have had some new idea...
Xavier, who is researching the Mikage Furnace, seems to have had some new idea...
Everything is ready. Now Xavier can start taking care of the issue regarding the Mikage Furnace...
A nameless samurai stands atop the windy sea cliffs, seemingly searching for something...
A rock pillar stands sentinel at the Serpent's Head, waiting silently for someone to come to repair it...
The ward at the Jakotsu Mine has been damaged. It awaits your urgent repair.
The ancient ruins of what is now called Fort Mumei rises slowly from beneath the waves. Amidst the cries of whales and waves, you can hear a hidden, ancient grudge...

entries.arabic_name: نظرة من على بُعد ثلاثة آلاف ميل
entries.description_en: Chouji, a young land selling ore on Yashiori Island, seems to be hiding an unfathomable secret...
Commission Officer Hiromi seems to be vexed about something. Perhaps he could use some help...
Lost friends, extinct sea creatures... Is this a sad reminiscence, or the beginning of a new life?
Xavier seems to be bothered by a certain matter...
You learn from Inazuma's Katheryne that the Inazuma Adventurers' Guild has been gathering adventurers to explore Seirai Island recently...

After arriving on Seirai island, you meet two adventurers who are currently investigating something known as a Warding Stone. But following the footprints of a cat, you arrive at a dilapidated shrine, in which sits a cat named "Neko," who proclaims itself to be the "provisional head priestess of the Asase Shrine." After you help "Neko" repair the shrine's Offering Box, it reveals the method of sealing the Warding Stones to you. Additionally, you learn that should you be able to seal all four Warding Stones throughout Seirai Island, you can calm the thunderstorm that enshrouds it.

After arriving on Seirai island, you meet two adventurers who are currently investigating something known as a Warding Stone. But following the footprints of a cat, you arrive at a dilapidated shrine, in which sits a cat named "Neko," who proclaims itself to be the "provisional head priestess of the Asase Shrine." After you help "Neko" repair the shrine's Offering Box, it reveals the method of sealing the Warding Stones to you. Additionally, you learn that should you be able to seal all four Warding Stones throughout Seirai Island, you can calm the thunderstorm that enshrouds it.

A taciturn wounded soldier is hiding inside a damaged boat on Nazuchi Beach — just another one of the thousand other tragedies that plague Yashiori Island, where the war has reached a temporary standstill...

It has been a while since you last contacted Sumida. She said earlier that she would look for some of the other people who took up her commission and conduct an information exchange. Go back to Inazuma and look for her to see how her attempt proceeds.
Katheryne seems to have a new commission for you.
You meet an odd bunch of people out in Inazuma's wilds...

entries.source_name: The Gourmet Supremos: The Deep Divers
entries.description_en: The Gourmet Supremos seem to be in another fix...
The famous adventurer Roald is still on Tsurumi Island, seemingly troubled by something...

entries.source_name: The Subterranean Trials of Drake and Serpent
entries.description_en: For treasure and for the future of Watatsumi Island, you accept Tsuyuko's commission and prepare to descend into Enkanomiya...
Kiminami Anna from the Kiminami Restaurant seems to be bothered by something...

entries.source_name: Neko Is a Cat: Wooden Shelf
entries.description_en: Neko, "Provisional Head Priestess of the Asase Shrine," seems to have business with you...

entries.source_name: Neko Is a Cat: Cat and Stone
entries.description_en: Neko, "Provisional Head Priestess of the Asase Shrine," seems to have business with you...

entries.source_name: Neko Is a Cat: A "Good Turn" Comes Late
entries.description_en: Neko, "Provisional Head Priestess of the Asase Shrine," seems to have business with you...
You decide to help Ema find the five missing books...
You discover a certain story within the hanging prison, and you go in search of...
After passing through The Moon-Bathed Deep, you come to a land that is foreign to you. You see no sign of any civilization at all, and so you decide to investigate further.
You help Clymene pay respects at seven royal tombs to lay the souls of the Sunchildren to rest...
Clear the trials according to the path prescribed by the spirit named Aberaku and obtain the offerings...
Clear the trials according to the path prescribed by the spirit named Aberaku and obtain the offerings...
Clear the trials according to the path prescribed by the spirit named Aberaku and obtain the offerings...

entries.source_name: About That Time We Saved the Tanuki Photo Board
entries.arabic_name: عن المرة التي أنقذنا فيها لوحة صور التانوكي
entries.description_en: Kimura, the Doushin in charge of maintaining order at the Irodori Festival, seems to be having a hard time...
There is a rather unique martial arts school in Inazuma, and its name is "Shinryuu."

entries.source_name: The Path of the Treasure-Seeker... Part II?
entries.arabic_name: درب الباحث عن الكنز... الجزء الثاني؟
entries.description_en: A certain fellow named Ulman is at the Inazuman seaside, puzzling over his present situation...
The Chief Technical Officer of the Crux Fleet has something she needs your help with...
Previous findings have caused Muzhen's research to make progress, but research is an ongoing process...
The task of locating Ruin machines is almost complete, but one thing continues to trouble Muzhen...
The prep work is complete. Now all that is left is to head into the ruins to confront those mysterious ancient machines...
You discover someone who is currently promoting Theater Mechanicus in Inazuma...
Something seems to be troubling Sakuya the florist...
The Inazuman angler Kujirai Momiji has something that she wants help with...

entries.source_name: By Thy Pale Beams I Solitary Rove
entries.description_en: Kujirai Momiji seems to have found some useful resources. Rendezvous with her, pronto...
You're out of Glowgrass Bait. Time to find Kujirai Momiji to make some more...
Sango says that her friend would like to modify the Ubiquity Net...

entries.source_name: Eight Locales Over Mountains and Seas: Soliloquy of Distant Island Peaks
entries.arabic_name: ثمانية مواقع عبر الجبال والبحار: مناجاة قمم الجزر البعيدة
entries.description_en: You agreed to Ioroi's request to "bring Kichiboushi out to train." Time to head to Guyun Stone Forest this time.

entries.source_name: Eight Locales Over Mountains and Seas: Blazing Poetry
entries.arabic_name: ثمانية مواقع عبر الجبال والبحار: شعر متأجج
entries.description_en: You agreed to Ioroi's request to "bring Kichiboushi out to train." Paimon plans to take him to see Luhua Pool today...
Inazuma's Komakata is promoting the latest version of Theater Mechanicus during the Irodori Festival...

You have received no commissions from Katheryne, nor do you have appointments with any friends. And yet, in the darkness, a golden light leads you to a small island in the middle of the ocean. How strange. What in the world happened?
Amidst the Irodori Festival, the florist Fushizome is looking for someone to experience the art of ikebana.
Amidst the Irodori Festival, the florist Fushizome is looking for someone to experience the art of ikebana.
The Mondstadt bard Lenne is discussing poetry quite passionately with the Inazuman poet Ootomo...
This time, it is Ootomo who wants to try his hand at writing Mondstadt-style poetry. Who knows what literary sparks might fly this time?
The hilichurls are causing chaos somewhere on Narukami Island. Furuya Noboru hopes that someone can put a stop to this quickly.
Vagrants are causing trouble somewhere on Narukami Island. Amano hopes that someone can help resolve the chaos.
Yashiori Island is experiencing a spot of automaton-related trouble. Satou hopes that someone can help quell the trouble.
Narukami Island's Sanden would like to have 5 Electro Crystals.
Narukami Island's Murakami would like to have 15 Mints.
Narukami Island's Matsumoto would like to have 5 servings of Teyvat Fried Egg.
The one who comes now is your most formidable opponent — and he is none other than Taroumaru, boss of Komore Teahouse!
Xu of the Feiyun Commerce Guild is currently puzzling over a device known as a Kamera...
Both Ei and Heizou mentioned this mysterious game. Go to the beach and check it out.
After experiencing the Akitsu Yuugei, a mysterious doorway suddenly appeared nearby...
Something new seems to be happening at the Grand Narukami Shrine...
Midori from Inazuma City seems to be troubled by something...
Atsuko, who is living in Liyue, seems to have something on her mind...

entries.source_name: O Archon, Have I Done Right?
entries.description_en: The shrine that Shouta has been giving sincere offerings to has stopped giving him replies. He seeks you out for help...
Asukara has discovered the Kairagi's whereabouts. The time has come for a rematch to reclaim his weapon...
Chisato, lady of the Hiiragi Clan, which leads the Kanjou Commission, requests that you help her bring a letter to her sweetheart, Kujou Kamaji...
According to Katheryne in Liyue Harbor, you will be able to find her on Narukami Island as well...

You and Paimon put in a good amount of hard work to sort your stories into a version that the children might find interesting. Thankfully, they like your stories. Although they don't seem to have told the truth about the mysterious creatures, this isn't the time to go into detail. Now, go with Rana to clear out some Withering Zones. You're doing this so the children of Vimara Village can play safely, after all.
You have taken care of the Withering Zones marked by Rana as well as the Spinocrocodiles. The children at Vimara Village should be safe now. Head back with Rana.
According to Arapacati, the rising pillars of smoke will lead to her brothers who are doing "cooking training." We need to find them and bring them back before the festival starts...

Aranakula, who is said to be rather timid, has gone to the Yasna Monument, which is flooded with dangerous Fungi. Aranakula has seldom been left alone without the company of soil and seeds, so the poor little thing must need help now...
Inarticulate Arabalika is exploring the Ruins of Dahri, where "Big Iron Chunks" abound, alone. Though he is a master of Ararakalari, it may be better to check in on him...

entries.source_name: A Short Encounter with a Rare Bird
entries.description_en: You bumped into a Forest Ranger, Shefket, who's carrying out ecological research in Sumeru's forests, and he told you about his Dusk Bird research. Can he really capture a Dusk Bird?
Somehow, you managed to open the entrance to the underground ruins. Once you find the core in the Dev's Cavern, the truth about the forest's "disease" will be unveiled...
After all the adventures with the Aranara in the forest, we are getting closer to Bija... Right? Anyway, let's check on Rana first.
You returned to Vanarana with Arama after parting with Arana and Rana. It's finally time for Festival Utsava.

entries.source_name: For the Children of the Past
entries.description_en: The Ashvattha Tree has been corroded. But from its fruit, Arama seems to have gained new knowledge, memories, and... manners of speech. According to Arama, you should eliminate Marana's Avatar next so that the new Ashvattha Tree may be born. Only then can the Bija be formed.

entries.source_name: For All Children Who Long for Life
entries.arabic_name: من أجل جميع الأطفال الذين يتوقون إلى الحياة
entries.description_en: Now, only the final enemy awaits vanquishing. Continue forward. Never, ever, stop moving forward.
Finally, you claimed the Bija. It's time to return to Rana.
The resourceful Araesha has prepared "delicious" riddles for Festival Utsava.
Seems that Arakanta wants to play Rishboland Tiger and Aranara.
Rescue the Aranara surrounded by monsters

entries.source_name: Look for and rescue the Aranara
entries.description_en: Look for and rescue the Aranara surrounded by monsters

There are several strange camps in the Sumeru forest, and each camp has a strange machine installed within. The Fatui seem to be using these machines to do something weird. It's best to investigate this matter...
In Aaru Village, there is a merchant from Mondstadt who needs help from adventurers.
Tirzad accidentally opened the hidden passage behind the mural. No one knows where it may lead...
You meet an old man named Khayyam in the forest. He seems to share a past with Aranara. It should do no harm to respond to his request for help...
After that last adventure, Aranakin really forgot a lot of things. No matter what, how could the new and old friends he made be forgotten so easily?
You helped Aragaru defeat the Eremites in Chatrakam Cave. Their goal, however, seems to be related to a friendship that Aragaru has forgotten...
Though lost memories flow by like water, friendships may be reborn with time...
You wonder how Ararycan is doing. Go find him when you have the time.
You found a journal by the Aranara named Arashakun in an Aranara house. Despite losing "courage," Arashakun still decided to venture into such a dangerous place. Go check the situation out...
There are so many Sweet Flowers in Vanarana's garden now. Varsha would be ecstatic to see it for herself for sure.
Somewhere in the desert in front of a giant ruin machine, Mahamata Afratu seems to be troubled by something...
Paimon found a painting in Vanarana that could be a treasure map...

entries.arabic_name: خصوبة مدفونة في الكثبان: الجزء الثالث
entries.description_en: This is the final part of the journey to the Eternal Oasis. With any luck, this will prove a smooth trip...
Kayvan the angler seems to be having some trouble...
You see an anxious person near the Akademiya...\n
Soheil's archaeological notes record his desert adventures in his youth. Some of the ruins mentioned may contain treasures and old records. Head into the depths of the desert again to look for them.
You find someone in danger in the outskirts of Sumeru...
Soheil's archaeological notes record his desert adventures in his youth. Some of the ruins mentioned may contain treasures and old records. Head into the depths of the desert again to look for them.
Soheil's archaeological notes record his desert adventures in his youth. Some of the ruins mentioned may contain treasures and old records. Head into the depths of the desert again to look for them.

entries.source_name: A Gifted Rose: Can Stones Bloom
entries.description_en: Affan's flowers still haven't sprouted. Try to help the disappointed fellow.

entries.source_name: A Gifted Rose: Some People Never Fade Away
entries.arabic_name: وردة موهوبة: بعض الناس لا يختفون أبداً
entries.description_en: Join others to witness the Golden Rose in full bloom.

entries.source_name: Behold, the Sign Comes Like A Thief...
entries.description_en: Yuften's goods appear to have been stolen by some unknown party. They need to be recovered.
Finally, you have arrived at the unchanging, eternal oasis, and thus is a great weight lifted off Jeht's shoulders...

entries.source_name: For Her Judgment Reaches to the Skies...
entries.description_en: Sometimes, the best way to deal with schemes is by brutal force — a knot that cannot be undone can be ripped apart.
You feel the calling of some mysterious presence after talking to Araja.
You need the help of the Pari Mihir and Rashnu to obtain the Chaplet. You might be able to find Mihir's trail in Asipattravana Swamp...
Access the Harvisptokhm through the path of the depths, and complete the final Rite of Ab-Zohr.
You need the help of the Pari Mihir and Rashnu to obtain the Chaplet. Rashnu seems to be around the giant tree at the Hills of Barsom...

entries.source_name: Rejoice With Me, for What Was Lost Is Now Found
entries.arabic_name: افرحوا معي، فما ضاع قد وُجد الآن
entries.description_en: Though Jeht made quick work of Aderfi, who had been a traitor to the Tanit tribe, you can't help but wonder how Benben's doing after being entrusted to him...
Something is bothering Arapacati lately...
Go to Zurvan to obtain the Twin-Horned Chaplet, and you will be able to go around collecting the Great Songs of Khvarena...

entries.source_name: As the Khvarena's Light Shows: Dukkha
entries.description_en: With Nasejuna's aid, you now know where the Great Songs might be found. One of them is hidden in a cave where the Wenut sleeps...

entries.source_name: Make Bright the Arrows, Gather the Shields...
entries.description_en: Jeht has not yet returned to the tribe, and now you can only count on the results of Babel's investigation...

entries.source_name: Join the Eremites and Embrace a Wonderful New Life!
entries.arabic_name: انضم إلى المرتزقة واستمتع بحياة جديدة رائعة!
entries.description_en: In Aaru Village, it seems that a member of the Eremites is recruiting...
Tadhla, Masseira's "Falcon," has been on a mission for a long time and has not returned. Thus Masseira asks you to find his "Falcon"...
After the previous adventure, it seems that Masseira still has some favor to ask of you...
You find an artist from Fontaine in distress in a cave by the water...
You find an artist from Fontaine in distress in a cave by the water...
There was a strange vibration in the ancient "training field" which, according to Liloupar, may have something to do with Gurabad's long past...

entries.source_name: Awaken the Residual Pari in the Fravashi Trees
entries.arabic_name: أيقظ الباري المتبقي في أشجار فراواشي
entries.description_en: The residual Pari residing within the Fravashi Trees are still trapped in obsessions of the past. It seems that Sorush can awaken them...

entries.source_name: Awaken the Residual Pari in the Fravashi Trees
entries.arabic_name: أيقظ الباري المتبقي في أشجار فراواشي
entries.description_en: The residual Pari residing within the Fravashi Trees are still trapped in obsessions of the past. It seems that Sorush can awaken them...

entries.source_name: Awaken the Residual Pari in the Fravashi Trees
entries.arabic_name: أيقظ الباري المتبقي في أشجار فراواشي
entries.description_en: The residual Pari residing within the Fravashi Trees are still trapped in obsessions of the past. It seems that Sorush can awaken them...

entries.source_name: Awaken the Residual Pari in the Fravashi Trees
entries.arabic_name: أيقظ الباري المتبقي في أشجار فراواشي
entries.description_en: The residual Pari residing within the Fravashi Trees are still trapped in obsessions of the past. It seems that Sorush can awaken them...

entries.source_name: Awaken the Residual Pari in the Fravashi Trees
entries.arabic_name: أيقظ الباري المتبقي في أشجار فراواشي
entries.description_en: The residual Pari residing within the Fravashi Trees are still trapped in obsessions of the past. It seems that Sorush can awaken them...
In the Tunigi Hollow, you, Paimon, and Sorush encounter an eccentric Pari. She seems to be preparing for some sort of trial...

entries.source_name: Investigate the Fatui Camps Marked by Sosi
entries.arabic_name: حقق في معسكرات الفاتوي التي حددتها سوسي
entries.description_en: According to Sosi, some uninvited guests seem to be coveting the divine powers of the monument. You might have to defeat their officer in order to drive them away...

entries.source_name: Awaken the Residual Pari in the Fravashi Trees
entries.arabic_name: أيقظ الباري المتبقي في أشجار فراواشي
entries.description_en: The residual Pari residing within the Fravashi Trees are still trapped in obsessions of the past. It seems that Sorush can awaken them...
According to Khedive, anyone carrying his handwritten "letter of recommendation" is guaranteed help from Purbiruni.
Did the kids like new carving? Did Tanger repent? Go to Port Ormos and find out.

entries.source_name: The Culling of the Worms: Gathering
entries.description_en: After running about, you manage to help Vinayak gather the components...

entries.source_name: The Culling of the Worms: Demonstration
entries.description_en: With a roar from the Wenutslayer Cannon, the Wenut falls to the ground...

entries.source_name: The Culling of the Worms: Presentation
entries.description_en: Based on Shriya's reasoning, you have successfully found where the root of the problem is...

entries.source_name: The Culling of the Worms: Ending
entries.description_en: In the desert, you once again see a familiar figure in the distance, but you don't hear the familiar arguing this time...
Dori says that she has the latest update on the Akademiya Extravaganza. Why not go and hear it?
There seems to be something else behind what Dori has told you. Why not go and ask her for more information?
Kaveh mentioned that he would be going to the Akademiya for some alone time. Perhaps you should go talk to him.
A visibly troubled adventurer from Liyue stands by the riverside in Sumeru. Is some kind of problem giving them grief...

entries.source_name: The Phantom Toy Master and the Barking Fox
entries.description_en: While taking a stroll through Veluriyam Mirage, you and Paimon notice a weary merchant. Perhaps giving her a hand may earn you a rare reward...
You meet a familiar-looking researcher sighing by the side of the road. Go ask him what's wrong.
Amir from Gandharva Ville needs eight servings of Raw Meat.
Arina from Sumeru City needs five Nilotpala Lotuses.
The Fatui are rampant...
Fungi are raging...
Fungi are raging...
Ruin Drakes are raging...
Fungi are raging...
The Corps of Thirty is hiring an assistant. Interested candidates, kindly contact Effendi at the Citadel of Regzar.
You run into a strange person near Sumeru City...
The area around the Dawn Winery has also been invaded by Forest Boars, and Farabi, who is trying his best to look for Snowboar traces, seems to be poking around that same area today...

entries.source_name: Target: Master of the Snowy Peaks!
entries.description_en: Farabi has sent a message asking you to meet him at Dragonspine. The target for today seems to be the legendary king of Snowboars...
You and Paimon were having a stroll across the Byakko Plain, intending to enjoy some hard-come-by peace and quiet, but you come across an unexpected conflict nonetheless...
Some sort of mistake seems to have been made in the voting process for Ayaka's outfit...
A certain engineer from Fontaine is currently performing some rather esoteric research...
Daya from Kshahrewar seems to be busy with something...
Farbal from Rtawahist seems to be busy with something...
Bahador from Spantamad seems to be busy with something...
Daneh from Vahumana seems to be busy with something...
Bahar from Haravatat seems to be busy with something...
After speaking of Mihir and the Oceanids, Sorush seemed to be at a loss. Zurvan's training has now progressed beyond its midpoint...\n
Sorush has finally realized that, at some point, she walked down a path of meaninglessness and absurdity. The training is approaching its conclusion...\n
You hear that there's a scholar out in the wild who's trying to recruit people to participate in a strange mirror-related activity. Maybe you should go take a look...

entries.arabic_name: سجل البحث: من أجل أحلام الطفولة!
entries.description_en: Despite two failures, Ranjit has no intention of backing down. Will he turn things around in Sumeru?

entries.arabic_name: وحدة إدارة الأزمات جاهزة للعمل بالكامل!
entries.description_en: Thanks to everyone's combined efforts, the Fieldwise Center has been fully developed and is running smoothly. At last, this period of relentless work has come to a close...
You find a familiar place in Sumeru City...

entries.source_name: Garcia's Paean: A Gift of Compatibility
entries.description_en: Mr. Garcia seems to be troubled by something...

entries.source_name: Upon a Flowery Field of Grass
entries.description_en: The owner of the flower garden has encountered a small problem...

entries.source_name: The Story of "the Princess" and "the Adventure Team"
entries.description_en: You have met many members from the Narzissenkreuz Adventure Team and have worked hard to successfully rescue the "Princess." Now go to the "magical fountain" mentioned by Ann, and board the water entity in mid-air.
Continue onward.
In the wilderness of Fontaine, you see a Melusine struggling against some Eremites.
Help Mamere collect the parts to repair Seymour.
You meet two people where you first met Virgil, and they have the same goal. They seem... nice. It's time to get an explanation from Virgil.
To investigate the secrets of the unfathomable book, you decide to work alongside Canotila...
In the sparsely populated wilderness, you suddenly heard strange arguing sounds...
Help Salsa place the object(s) in a suitable location.
Help Salsa place the object(s) in a suitable location.
Help Salsa place the object(s) in a suitable location.
Help Salsa place the object(s) in a suitable location.

entries.source_name: Good Stuff, but Terrible Taste — Continued
entries.arabic_name: أشياء جيدة، لكن مذاقها فظيع: تابع
entries.description_en: The traps set by the evil person in green have yet to be taken down...

entries.source_name: Scenes from Life in Meropide: Fists of Fury
entries.arabic_name: مشاهد من الحياة في ميروبيد: قبضات الغضب
entries.description_en: Nizami is looking to spar...

entries.source_name: Scenes from Life in Meropide: Safe Operation
entries.arabic_name: مشاهد من الحياة في ميروبيد: عملية آمنة
entries.description_en: It seems someone is in trouble in the abandoned production zone...
Iaune from the Maison Gestion is likely still hard at work...
A fountain on Erinnyes seems to have... a small problem...
Help Verenata give the potions she has made to Carabosse. They appear to be conducting some music-related experiment...
Verenata seems to be troubled by something. Go help her out.
You have collected seven mysterious cores in accordance with Henri's instructions. It's time to go back and look for Henri.
In order to find Puca's token, you once again visit the vein from before...
The troubles of Cosanzeana the little florist continue...
In the Court of Fontaine, you meet a group of people from Liyue...

entries.source_name: In Search of Lost Time: North
entries.description_en: There seem to be some peculiar, tall towers near the Fontaine Research Institute...
The story continues. For Ann, please keep going.
Give Chesil's prototype clock to Puca. Perhaps a new production line will be born from this.

entries.source_name: Scenes from Life in Meropide: Chit-Chat
entries.arabic_name: مشاهد من الحياة في ميروبيد: دردشة
entries.description_en: Nakul is looking for a suitable place to study...

entries.source_name: Scenes from Life in Meropide: Visible Hands
entries.arabic_name: مشاهد من الحياة في ميروبيد: الأيدي المرئية
entries.description_en: Maupoil, a Fortress of Meropide guard, is still working tirelessly to cover for other people...
Trace and find the Narzissenkreuz Ordo's seals.
Trace and find the Narzissenkreuz Ordo's seals.
You encounter a mysterious light-emitting device within some peculiar underwater ruins...
You discover a great tree that resembles a wilting waterfall. What secrets lie here?
You discover a furious lake. What happened here?
You finally have all three Waterdrop keys. According to Pahsiv, these are key to stopping Erinnyes from "Melusine-ing."

entries.source_name: Go to the Institute Dormitories and retrieve the Anchor
entries.arabic_name: اذهب إلى مساكن المعهد واستعد المرساة
entries.description_en: You arrived at the new Fontaine Research Institute and met with co-administrators Raimondo and Choiseul. After a long, mind-numbing conversation, you were tasked to escort Nacker and retrieve the last two Anchors.

entries.source_name: Our Purpose Is in Another Canal
entries.description_en: Repairing the Fortress of Meropide's piping is no mean feat...
You discover a building in the wilds that seems to have an unknown purpose...
The Steambird seems to have had a crime unfold on their own doorstep...
Ms. Qiu's group seems to be in trouble again...
After clearing Rocher and Kevin of suspicion, an organization known as the "Elegant Tableware Confrerie" has become of interest to you...
You see a familiar face in the Court of Fontaine...

Seymour's lost data has been retrieved, but the scattered fragments must be put together as soon as possible. All possible connections must be attempted to complete the prototype's initial and final mission...
You and Paimon are attracted by the aroma of roast chicken...
You meet Iaune again at the Fontaine Research Institute...
After a thorough investigation, the Fontaine Research Institute seems to have found a lead on Nacker and the Arkhium Kinetic Core. Now, all that's left is to bring him to justice.
In a wondrous room, Caterpillar recalls something...
On the shores of Romaritime Harbor, a merchant named Kesean appears to be in a bit of a pickle...
The deadline for retrieving the Violetglow Jellyfish is nearing. It's time to check in on how Kesean's doing...
You've gotten a new job...
You arranged to meet with Benoit today...
Molli still seems to want to go to Benoit's house...
You find yourselves near the Leroy residence again...
In the Primordial Sea, face Narzissenkreuz's dream of salvation.

entries.source_name: Impromptu Poem of the Crimson Dawn
entries.description_en: You meet someone locked in a cage in the suburbs...
You encounter a series of strange occurrences after arriving in Petrichor for the first time. You decide to get to the bottom of it all...
In order to rescue the people of Petrichor, you follow the strange cat named "Osse" into the mysterious Faded Castle...
For Monsieur Os, and for everyone in town, take on Boethius in a final battle!

entries.arabic_name: إعادة بناء القناة الذهبية: الجزء الأول
entries.description_en: To enter "Domus Aurea," you must rebuild the ancient golden aqueducts...

entries.arabic_name: إعادة بناء القناة الذهبية: الجزء الثاني
entries.description_en: To enter "Domus Aurea," you must rebuild the ancient golden aqueducts...

entries.source_name: A Gift From the Sea Spirits
entries.description_en: By the gentle shores of Fontaine, you and Paimon meet a Melusine who needs your help...
Will the battle between clockwork workshop and clock shop, the wall between two brothers, dissolve when the two bosses meet? Or will the conflict grow more intense?
Alberre is responsible for data collection. Go see what you need to do...
Armand of Lepaute Horlogerie is in charge of taking care of their toys. Go see how you can try those gizmos out...
After Turenna's departure, the event welcomes another special Melusine player...
Two Gardes stop you. Just what are they doing...
Having completed Frejus and Chenee's remote cannon experiment, it's time to go back and talk to them.
After a spate of spirited fishing, you manage to halt the spread of invasive fish in Fontaine's waters. Meanwhile, you receive some good news from the Maison Gardiennage...

In a corner of the Court of Fontaine, Turenna and Enghiene, members of the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol, have set up a new tabletop wargame. The stage is set for you to show off your tactical brilliance...
Muirne needs 3 servings of Butter.
Pruniere requires 5 White Iron Chunks.
Paban needs 8 bottles of Milk.
Ismenor needs 5 Bulle Fruit.
Etienne needs 8 servings of Raw Meat.
Clockwork meka are causing trouble...
Ruin Drakes are raging...
Clockwork meka are causing trouble...
Tainted Hydro Phantasms are causing trouble...
Ah, Fontaine! Another nation... another Katheryne...

entries.source_name: Studies in Light and Shadow: A Fontaine of Enchantment
entries.arabic_name: دراسات في الضوء والظل: سحر فونتين
entries.description_en: In Fontaine's countryside, a man named Bresson seems to have encountered some trouble...
Blacksmiths in Fontaine do not hammer their metals themselves, but rather use an even more advanced method. If you have time, you really should go check it out...

entries.source_name: The Peaks and Troughs of Life
entries.description_en: Researcher Macadell of the institute seems to be troubled by something...
Mr. Petit Lumiere seems to have a unique understanding of films...

entries.source_name: The Art of the Elegant Blade Dance?
entries.description_en: In a nondescript corner of Belleau Region, you and Paimon discover the entrance to a Domain. A Blade Dancer in high spirits extends a special invitation to you...
After experiencing a unique battle on the Blade Dancer's stage, you and Paimon plan to give Costentin some feedback, but discover something has changed...

entries.source_name: Search Chronicle: Audience with the Solitary King!
entries.description_en: Although his plan to make new buddies is not going well, Ranjit seems unconcerned. Indeed, he is already preparing for the next challenge...
Reunite with an old friend at Café Lutece...
After hearing the sound of "cro-cro~~KOOM" by chance, you and Paimon discover an engineer who seems to be tinkering with a very unusual device...
After having just arrived in Natlan, you are teleported to a strange space...
Help Titu resolve the Shadow Pin issue and reinforce the seal placed upon the Abyss.
The Greater Shadow Pin falls, opening a huge hole in the ground...

entries.source_name: To the Night, What is the Night's
entries.description_en: You encounter a strange door out in the wilds of Natlan...
In the depths of some searing ruins, you meet a young woman...
Your Saurian buddy wants to make some new friends...
Wouldn't it be great if you could catch some fish for your Saurian buddy...? Ace Angler Paimon, you're up!
Go to the Children of Echoes and search for clues concerning the Volcanic Token.
Time to look for Tisoc, the missing guard...
You encounter a child looking for star shards out in the wild...
It's time you shot a film starring your Saurian companion!
You encounter someone surrounded by three Saurians out in the wild...
After running into a whole bunch of Tepetlisaurs while you're out on the road, you let your Saurian companion go off to play with them. But then it doesn't come back...
You find an injured Saurian out in the wild...

"Dad, the heroes you've trained are all perfect, right?"\n"It's not like that. Perfection always feels like it's just beyond reach, so the desire to achieve it gnaws at the very fiber of their being — but they'll never do it. Just like us, they'll get tired and want to give up."
"What we trainers pursue, myself included, isn't success..."

entries.source_name: The Case of the Crafting Bench
entries.description_en: You discover a strange Crafting Bench in the Stadium of the Sacred Flame...
Your Saurian companion gifts you the treasures it had been carefully collecting. Now, what would make a good thank-you gift...?
Your Saurian buddy digs up a strange seed...
Whenever you're in trouble, won't you stand by me?
As you get closer to the island in the fog, a strange noise can be heard from it — what secret past lies hidden in its depths?
You've discovered a hidden chamber deep within the Isle of Night...
Following Cocouik's guidance, you come to the palace ruins on Ochkanatlan's upper levels. There seems to be something hidden beneath these ruins...

entries.source_name: The Other Side of the Sky
entries.description_en: Passing through an ocean of clouds, you finally arrive at the legendary Tonatiuh...
Go back to the Tonatiuh and meet up with your companion.

entries.source_name: An Omen of Annihilation and the Final Entreaty
entries.description_en: To enter the Heart of the Sacred Mountain, one need only offer up two Golden Entreaties... That should dispel the Flamelord's Blessing that presently affects your saurian buddy...

entries.source_name: As the Burning Sun Sears Shadows
entries.description_en: The Heart of the Sacred Mountain is infested by the Abyss. Its influence must be eliminated.
According to Bona, you need to collect burning Firestones and offer them up to the Altar of Primal Flame if you wish to find the Jade of Return...
Having obtained the permit, the time has arrived for you to activate the Secret Source Dragon Idol and enter the Heart of the Sacred Mountain.
Shall "intensity" vanquish the cold, or must some other step up to the plate?

entries.source_name: The Attack of the... Purple Tepetlisaurus?
entries.description_en: A merchant caravan seems to have met with some mishap on the path to the volcano...
In order to uncover a path to the Heart of the Sacred Mountain, it appears you must cleanse the Abyss that is corrupting the ancient ruins...
Mualani seems excited about the Wavey Bay attractions. Go meet up with her!
You encounter a strange Nochtlin on the hill beside Wavey Bay...
You encounter a nursery full of blooming Brewblossoms in the wilderness of Tete Isle. It appears to be administered by a mysterious woman...
Word has it that the Easybreeze Holiday Resort is hosting a Pipilpan Idol Competition...

entries.source_name: Strange Encounter of the Tete Isle Kind
entries.arabic_name: لقاء غريب من نوع جزيرة تيتي
entries.description_en: You encounter a mysterious bald-headed figure in the wilderness of Tete Isle...
The Children of Echoes' dances leave Paimon in awe, and beneath the stage, a certain artist from Natlan with unique views notices the budding talent you and Paimon possess...

entries.source_name: Last Ride of the Bugbuster Squad
entries.description_en: The work of catching Abyssal Aphids is making steady progress, and today is the final mission...
A letter from the People of the Springs beckons you and Paimon to a special party hosted by Mualani. It's time to take the stage...
Near the Children of Echoes, a creator is recommending her new game to the children...
You meet Katheryne once again in Natlan...
While at the Easybreeze Holiday Resort, you bump into someone who is telling stories...
You discover a huge stage at the Easybreeze Holiday Resort... along with someone mixing strange drinks beside it...
You are about to travel to the nation of snow, and Paimon seems to be sorting through all the photos you have taken along the way...
Breaking into the heavily guarded Fatui facility was unexpectedly easy...
You discover an island affected by kuuvahki turbulence near Hiisi Island...
At the northern training ground, you're suddenly stopped by a treasure hunter who seems very enthusiastic...
On Hiisi Island, the angler Pekkani finds himself puzzled by an unseen force disturbing his catch...
You discover a strange tree at the Eye of Kratti...
You stumble upon someone calling for help in a thunderstorm, and he seems to definitely need some...
This small valley doesn't seem as peaceful as it looks...
You spot a strange blue orb in the Nothing Passage at the northern end of Lempo Isle...
A strange phenomenon occurred in the Nothing Passage at the northern end of Lempo Isle...
The Damselette is having a spot of trouble in the Silvermoon Hall...
The kuuhenki are up to something interesting in the Silvermoon Hall...
A small animal seems to be in trouble at the Silvermoon Hall...
The Damselette appears to have some interesting things to share at the Silvermoon Hall...

entries.source_name: The Artist By the Moon's Side (I)
entries.description_en: The Damselette is having a spot of trouble in the Silvermoon Hall...
Listen to the ghosts' whispers and retrieve their names.

Treasure hunters attempting to scavenge riches from the wreckage of a pirate ship claim to have been attacked by a ghost. While the Eye of Kratti is no stranger to rumors of haunted sightings, there has never been a documented case of ghosts assaulting the living. Perhaps questioning Ilmari, who often fishes nearby, might reveal more information.
The Damselette seems to be playing with kuuhenki in the Silvermoon Hall...

entries.source_name: The Artist By the Moon's Side (II)
entries.description_en: The Damselette is having a spot of trouble in the Silvermoon Hall...
The Damselette seems to have something she wants to do in the Silvermoon Hall...
It seems that many Seelie are gathering at the center of Amsvartnir...
The Damselette seems to be playing with kuuhenki in the Silvermoon Hall...
The Damselette seems to have something she wants to do in the Silvermoon Hall...
You hear a strange recording about the "apocalypse" at the lake to the west of Piramida...
You have agreed to meet Illuga at Cliffwatch Camp once preparations are complete and take part in the next phase of the operation.

entries.source_name: The Last Night, the First Light
entries.description_en: The Spiralblade has been retrieved. You must return to Piramida without delay.
The Great Treasure is within reach...
Jahoda has received a new commission from the Adventurers' Guild. However, for Jahoda, this commission seems a little different than usual...

entries.source_name: The Artist By the Moon's Side (IV)
entries.description_en: Columbina is having a spot of trouble in the Silvermoon Hall...

entries.source_name: The Moon Adorning the Night: The Three Moons
entries.arabic_name: القمر الذي يزين الليل: الأقمار الثلاثة
entries.description_en: Columbina seems to have something she wants to do in the Silvermoon Hall...
Columbina seems to have something she wants to do in the Silvermoon Hall...
The Silvermoon Hall is bathed in silence today...
Zompaynco from Natlan seems to be troubled by something...
After hearing about Dhabit's "business," Nefer seems to have something she wants to say to him...
There seems to be a dilapidated campsite below Cliffwatch Camp...
After hearing about Dhabit's "business," Jahoda seems to have something she wants to say to him...
Before you even realize, you've filled up the entire photo album. Think back on all these special moments together with Paimon.
On the outskirts of Paha Isle, a fierce wargame simulation seems to be unfolding...
After days of intense "sparing," the moment of parting quietly arrives...
The sun will always pierce the darkness and shine hope down...
Thanks to your tireless efforts in collecting materials, the Krumkake Craftshop's workbench has a spanking new groove...
You once again encounter a familiar face at the Adventurers' Guild in Nod-Krai...
Lyylikki, who is in charge of food distribution, seems to be in some trouble...
The Lightkeepers stationed at Cliffwatch Camp seem to have run into some trouble...
After completing the mage's lodge, the sounds of laughter and cheer can be heard coming from within...
The Knights of Favonius's expeditionary force seems to be anticipating something...
The dance exchange has been incredibly fruitful for both the Natlan and Sumeru dancers...
You discover a strange conch shell on Twinning Isle in the Golden Apple Archipelago. The sounds that come from within seem to hint at something...
No one knows why, but this island seems to be forever affected by strange weather conditions...
You discover a strange wrecked ship on a nameless island. But the question is, where did this ship come from?

entries.source_name: The Other Side of Isle and Sea
entries.description_en: You discover a strange mural in the Golden Apple Archipelago...
A mysterious, joyous gift lies somewhere, waiting to be discovered...
The Fatui team members you've brought back to their senses have all returned to the camp on the central island. You wonder if the Geochanter Bracer named Yakov has regained his wits or not...
A bake-danuki seems to be looking for help on Pudding Isle...

entries.source_name: Drama Phantasmagoria: Tale of the Sword-Wielding Princess!
entries.arabic_name: دراما فانتازماغوريا: حكاية الأميرة حاملة السيف!
entries.description_en: The great Prinzessin's loyal subjects are pleased to perform for you, our guests, a performance most special: a tale of love and valor...
Miitoboru seems to have some request. Time to ask him about the details...
Go near to the reef of Minacious Isle to see if the pirates have left a clue to the treasure's location there.
Mondstadt's Katheryne has a gift to pass on to you. It seems to have come from dancing bake-danuki...?

"To save their fallen friends, the now-alone Hydro Eidolon must break into the haunted fortress, and find a way to lift the curse..."\nIntrigued, you and Paimon arrive at the set of "Petrifying Gaze"...

"A town floating in the sky encounters an unprecedented crisis, and a miracle-working architect must act quickly to prevent the soaring city from crashing to the ground..."\nIntrigued, you and Paimon arrive at the set of Skycastle Saviors...

Following the tracks of a Choo-Choo Cart line, you and Paimon run into an enormous space in the cave with a mysterious mural in a very conspicuous spot, which seems to be illustrating someone's story in the "Veluriyam Mirage"...

Jeroney wishes to be able to see the starry sky whenever he wants, so why not take a photo of it for him? Even if it's only the reflection inside the bottle and not the real thing, it will be beautiful enough.
Long ago, this mysterious domain appeared in Teyvat. To probe its arcane secrets, one must enter stone walls, ride carts, and raise the lamp in the tent. But, what is it all for?
